# Wallet-kit corpus coverage review (2026-11-06)

This review compares what the 2026-11-06 discovery run observed live against the 57 lead URLs, which have not been checked live. Kit labels for the leads come from the lead text only. No kit is called "confirmed" unless the discovery run saw that kit's own modal open.

## Where coverage stands

### Verified live

Source: `/Users/pankajyadav/programming/ethGlobal/Igris/corpus/discovery/discovery-2026-11-06.md`.

| Kit | Confirmed production sites | Vendor demos (don't count as production) | SDK signals seen live, but no kit modal |
|---|---|---|---|
| RainbowKit | **1**: app.gearbox.fi | rainbowkit.com | none |
| Reown AppKit | **4**: app.spark.fi, app.ethena.fi, app.pendle.finance, swap.cow.fi | lab.reown.com | morpho, compound, portal.zksync, manifold, debank (all appkit/medium) |
| Web3Modal (legacy) | **0** | none | none |
| Dynamic | **1**: bungee.exchange (opened from "Sign in") | none | none |
| Privy | **4**: matcha.xyz, zora.co, rarible.com, app.virtuals.io | demo.privy.io | uniswap, hyperliquid, jumper, stargate, opensea (all privy/low) |

**All five kits have fewer than 5 confirmed production deployments.** RainbowKit, Dynamic and Web3Modal are critically thin at 1, 1 and 0.

### Leads (not verified live), grouped by evidence strength

The evidence tier is my reading of each lead's wording, not something I checked.

| Kit | Source-code level | Bundle-string level | Vendor marketing only | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RainbowKit | nouns.build, efp.app, app.mento.org, nexus.hyperlane.xyz, speedrunethereum.com, abi.ninja (6) | app.aura.finance, swap.defillama.com, app.cabana.fi, app.lagoon.finance, app.dhedge.org, app.sommelier.finance, app.mellow.finance, kerneldao.com/kelp, party.app, kwenta.eth.limo (10) | none | 16 |
| AppKit | eth.blockscout.com, app.aragon.org, v2.kleros.builders, app.passport.xyz, ambient.finance, app.snowbridge.network, app.aleph.cloud, remix.live, app.spritz.chat (9); wolfswap.app (served HTML) | none | oku.trade, dapp.quickswap.exchange, dune.com (3) | 13 |
| Web3Modal | app.exact.ly (v3), bridge.taiko.xyz (v4), stability.farm (v4), louper.dev (v5), app.kodo.exchange (v4 ethers), app.thebadge.xyz (v4 + SIWE), depeg.etherisc.com (v2) (7) | none | gempad.app (v3) | 8 |
| Dynamic | app.eclipse.xyz, app.p2p.me, actions.optimism.io, trustswap.intuition.box, starkgate.starknet.io (5) | none | app.lighter.xyz, app.defi.app, ondo.finance, arena.social (4) | 9 |
| Privy | app.gmx.io, app.unlock-protocol.com, karmahq.xyz, pro.hatsprotocol.xyz, app.hypha.earth, play.negationgame.com, crowdstake.fun (7) | none | pro.edgex.exchange, courtyard.io, paragraph.com, glider.fi, football.fun, based.app, terminal.merit.systems (7) | 14 |

## Gaps by kit and configuration

### RainbowKit

1. **Confirmed production base is too small (1 site).** gearbox's configuration was not recorded (grouping, modalSize, SIWE).
   - To close: confirm at least 4 more live. Good first picks are the near-default leads (swap.defillama.com, sommelier, mellow) and the custom-group leads (lagoon with its "Safe" group, aura).
2. **No public SIWE flow on the main connect path.**
   - nouns.build is the only source-level candidate.
   - speedrunethereum.com enables SIWE only under `/admin`, so a public scan can't reach it.
   - The aura and kwenta signals are bare `SiweMessage` string counts. That is not evidence of `RainbowKitAuthenticationProvider`.
   - To close: at least 2 more public dapps that mount `RainbowKitAuthenticationProvider` on the header connect button, so the sign-message step after connect can be observed.
3. **Default `ConnectButton` vs `ConnectButton.Custom` is never checked live.** Every Custom or `useConnectModal` case (nouns.build, efp, mento, speedrun, abi.ninja) comes from source only.
   - To close: record, per site, whether `[data-testid="rk-connect-button"]` exists. rainbowkit.com showed it; gearbox showed no static signal, which suggests Custom but hasn't been verified.
4. **Hosting variance.** kwenta.eth.limo is the only IPFS/ENS-gateway deployment. A gateway can serve a stale build.
   - To close: one more gateway-hosted RainbowKit dapp.

### Reown AppKit

1. **No confirmed AppKit site with email or social login.**
   - All 4 confirmed sites only show `wui-list-wallet`. Whether email or social buttons were present was not recorded.
   - The leads are all indirect: kleros and remix use defaults; spritz hides socials with CSS, so the DOM may contain socials that aren't visible; oku and quickswap are vendor claims.
   - To close: at least 2 production sites with `features.email: true` and a non-empty `socials` list, verified by seeing the email input or social buttons in the modal.
   - Caveat: AppKit ≥1.7 can take features from the Reown dashboard, so source config does not prove deployed config.
2. **Ethers adapter is never confirmed.** Leads: ambient, snowbridge, aleph (ethers v5), remix. lab.reown.com `?name=ethers` is a vendor demo.
   - To close: at least 1 confirmed production ethers-adapter site.
3. **Multichain (EVM + Solana) is never confirmed.** Leads: wolfswap (Vue/Nuxt), aleph, spritz.
   - The Bitcoin adapter appears only in quickswap's vendor claim and in remix's network list.
   - To close: at least 2 confirmed EVM+Solana sites, where the modal shows a chain or namespace selector.
4. **Framework and version spread is unverified.**
   - Vue: wolfswap only.
   - Pinned old UI: passport (`=1.5.0`) only.
   - Runtime-switched kit: blockscout picks AppKit or Dynamic per instance, and which one eth.blockscout.com uses has not been checked.
5. **Missing configurations:**
   - AppKit with SIWX/SIWE.
   - AppKit opened only from code via `useAppKit().open()` with no `appkit-button` (remix is the only lead).
6. **Cheapest gains.** Five corpus sites already show static AppKit signals but failed for navigation reasons:
   - morpho and portal.zksync: a pre-connect disclaimer dialog blocked the click.
   - compound and manifold: no connect control matched the strict scoring.
   - debank: a cookie banner was showing and the modal didn't appear.

### Web3Modal (legacy)

1. **No deployments confirmed live, and the detector can't tell Web3Modal from AppKit.**
   - The current appkit fingerprint treats `appkit-modal, w3m-modal, appkit-button, w3m-button` as a single signal. A v3–v5 Web3Modal site would be labelled "appkit".
   - Fix: separate the two. Treat `w3m-modal` registered without any `appkit-*` element as Web3Modal. Storage key prefixes `@w3m/` vs `@appkit/` are another discriminator: wolfswap's lead shows `@appkit/...`. The `@w3m/` prefix is an assumption to verify live.

## Category and structural gaps

1. **Domain skew.** About 70% of the corpus and most leads are DeFi or bridges. Under-represented:
   - games
   - consumer and social apps (only zora, hey, paragraph, arena, football.fun)
   - Telegram mini-apps (crowdstake only)
   - developer tools (remix, louper, abi.ninja; all leads)
   - NFT mint and launchpad pages
2. **Frameworks.** Non-React deployments are all unverified leads: Vue (wolfswap), Svelte (taiko, louper), Astro (stability). There are no confirmed non-React kit sites.
3. **Configuration is never recorded live.** Discovery records which kit appeared but not:
   - email or social inputs
   - wallet group headings (for example "Popular", "Installed", "Recommended")
   - RainbowKit compact vs wide modal
   - a SIWE step after connect
   - a chain or namespace selector

   Until it does, no configuration (as opposed to kit) can count as verified.
4. **Navigation blockers hide real kit sites.**
   - 6 sites are bot-blocked by Cloudflare: euler, arbitrum bridge, magiceden, layer3, zerion, zapper.
   - 2 returned HTTP errors: eigenlayer 500, balancer 403.
   - app.safe.global timed out.
   - At least 4 were blocked by disclaimer or consent dialogs: morpho, zksync, metamask portfolio, ether.fi.

   The leads include eth.limo gateway and Cloudflare-fronted sites that will hit the same problems. To decide what to replace, separate "blocked" from "no kit".
5. **Out-of-scope kits.** ConnectKit (aave, confirmed), Magic (polymarket) and custom modals (sky, lido, curve, 1inch, across, superbridge, opensea, snapshot, highlight, guild, hey, defisaver) make up about 13 of the 21 unidentified sites. They are good negative controls but add no coverage for the five target kits.
